questions.question: Why did King Baasha of Israel fortify the town of Ramah?

answers.text: To block anyone going in or out of Judah
To guard his own border against the Philistines
To build a brand new capital for Israel

questions.question: What did the seer Hanani say was wrong with King Asa's deal with the king of Aram?

answers.text: Asa relied on Aram and not the LORD
Asa bowed down to the gods of Aram
Asa made the deal on the Sabbath day

questions.question: When the seer Hanani rebuked King Asa of Judah, what did the enraged king do to him?
When King Asa of Judah became diseased in his feet, whom did he seek instead of the LORD?
